scripts.build: npm run generate && esbuild --bundle --format=esm --banner:js='import { createRequire } from "node:module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);' --outfile=./dist/index.js --platform=node --target=node22 ./src/index.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write src prisma.config.ts README.md package.json tsconfig.json && prisma format
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src prisma.config.ts README.md package.json tsconfig.json
